name: Roledependentnames Pattern
description: Diagram | Intent: | An ontology design pattern for modeling Names as part of Roles, to capture scenarios where an Agent performs different Roles using different Names associated with the different Roles. Examples of an Agent performing a Role using different Names are rather ubiq- uitous, e.g., authors...
competency_questions: Under which name does someone act when they take on a particular role, such as the name an author publishes under?; Given a name, who is behind it and which role were they acting in under that name?; Who or what makes a given role available, and under which names is that role held?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard 1.127.0 review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
